primary_candidate.name: B_anchored_common_positive_support_minimum
primary_candidate.scales: exact saved b_local calibration, no refit
primary_candidate.tie_rule: retain B if no strictly positive challenger

data_gate.eligible_source: new documented unexposed cohort with full current-class coverage
data_gate.require_exposure_ledger: no known fit/tuning/evaluation exposure; UNKNOWN fails truly-unused claim
data_gate.patient_isolation: must describe available identifiers honestly; current HK IDs establish exact-image identity only
data_gate.power_plan: Before scoring, use development-only paired disagreement assumptions and actual candidate group sizes; use documented sensitivity bounds. No test predictions, no unblinding to set sample size. Require sufficient planned precision/power; 50 alone never passes this gate.

endpoint.primary: image-level macro recall difference candidate minus B, separately per dataset

uncertainty.method: paired class-stratified known-group bootstrap, resample groups with all member images; identical draws for all arms
uncertainty.interpretation: approximate conditional uncertainty of frozen models and observed cohort, not training-seed variability or verified-patient uncertainty

decision_rationale: 1 pp is a pre-unblinding practical gain threshold; -1 pp preserves earlier old/new protection tolerance with uncertainty added. These are design criteria, not a clinical standard.
stops: Any data exposure UNKNOWN/known, overlap, insufficient class coverage, or inadequate planned power: stop before inference.
Any reference binding, scale, mapping or invariant error: mark invalid, preserve outputs; no performance-driven retry.
Missing classes or low independent-group counts after lock: no post-hoc exclusion/replacement.
Either dataset fails efficacy or old/new protection: no cross-dataset success claim; CI crossing zero is inconclusive, not evidence of no effect.
Do not switch primary candidate, choose a better reference arm, pool away a negative dataset, scan thresholds, increase seeds or modify rules after results.
A failed or inconclusive completed confirmation ends this fixed-route campaign; any new method requires a separately agreed new protocol and fresh unexposed data.
authorization: This file freezes design only. No model execution, E/test score inspection, training, download, resplitting or monitoring is authorized by this audit.
